name: SikaRoof® VersiEdge™ P
tagline: EDGE PROFILE FOR CONTAINMENT AND SEGMENTING OF LANDSCAPE FEATURES
summary: SikaRoof® VersiEdge™ P is a high strength edge profile designed to retain and frame vegetated roof gardens. The edge profile is manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and is used to separate planting media and aggregates from other materials in the rooftop area. SikaRoof® VersiEdge™ P has a L-shaped design to utilise the weight of the green roof build-up to keep the barrier in place allowing the zoning of different elements in rooftop gardens.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Products must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
